_readme: Dispatch-rule presets for Marble Jar. Install with:  jq -c '.rules[]' dispatch-rules.json | while read -r rule; do curl -sS -X POST "$MARBLE_JAR_URL/v1/rules" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MARBLE_JAR_API_KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "$rule"; done  — needs a key with rules:write. Preview any condition first with POST /v1/rules/test. Fields: project, model, agent, status, source, summary, cost_usd, tokens_in, tokens_out, tokens_total, duration_ms. Operators: eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, contains, in, exists. Combine with all / any / not. Replace the target_config placeholders before installing.

rules.name: Failed work opens a Jira bug
Anything touching payments gets a Teams post
Security-sensitive summaries go to the internal webhook
Long runs are reviewed by a human
